directions.name: K 字钥匙
directions.detail: An original monogram combining a lowercase k and one key. A bold upright stem has a generous circular open key bow near its upper left, with two clean diagonal branches extending toward the right to form a recognizable k. The diagonal lower branch can end in one small square key tooth. One cohesive connected silhouette, exceptionally simple, optically balanced, rounded corners, mature and friendly. Readable instantly as a k-shaped key at 24px.
directions.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: Keysy app and website icon concept, one standalone symbol.
Brand purpose: organizing API keys and private credential files. User needs multiple shape alternatives, and each exact shape must be reusable with any single CSS color in both light and dark themes.
Primary request: An original monogram combining a lowercase k and one key. A bold upright stem has a generous circular open key bow near its upper left, with two clean diagonal branches extending toward the right to form a recognizable k. The diagonal lower branch can end in one small square key tooth. One cohesive connected silhouette, exceptionally simple, optically balanced, rounded corners, mature and friendly. Readable instantly as a k-shaped key at 24px.
Style: professional original flat vector-like logo design, solid filled monochrome ink, precise smooth contours, simple memorable geometry. Strictly ONE uniform foreground color, near-black #202520, at 100% opacity with clean antialiased edges only. The shapes and negative spaces are the design; no tonal rendering.
Composition: square canvas; ONE icon centered, filling about 65% of canvas width and height with generous even transparent padding. Front facing flat 2D. Transparent background with real alpha. Every interior negative-space cutout must also be truly transparent, not white.
Constraints: deliver the icon alone, no words, no letters outside the integrated mark, no title, no numbering, no labels, no contact sheet, no color variants, no mockups, no app-icon background tile separate from the mark, no checkerboard painted into image, no gradients, no shadows, no 3D, no metallic surfaces, no glow, no textures, no fine lines or tiny ornamental details. Do not imitate an existing technology company logo.

directions.name: 圆角钥匙孔
directions.detail: An original compact emblem built from a vertically oriented soft rounded capsule or softly squared arch with one generous, perfectly clear keyhole cut out of its center. The negative-space keyhole consists of a round head flowing into a short tapered stem; a subtle asymmetry in the outer lower-right contour suggests the letter k without adding decoration. Bold simple iconic silhouette, generous negative space, calm premium approachable software brand, readable at 24px. Avoid the standard shield outline and avoid padlock shackles.

directions.name: 双环钥匙扣
directions.detail: An original minimal abstract keyring mark: two thick smoothly rounded open loops interlock in a compact diagonal arrangement. Together they suggest a small keychain and a lowercase k through negative space. Solid flat geometric bands of consistent weight, just two large purposeful apertures, no thin details. Contemporary calm premium software identity, softer and more playful than a padlock, highly distinctive silhouette readable at 24px. Not a chain-link favicon clone; create your own optically balanced geometry.

directions.name: 收纳盒
directions.detail: An original minimal secure-storage brand symbol: a soft rounded square pocket/container with a bold lowercase k cut out as transparent negative space. Its top edge has a single small inset notch suggesting an organized card drawer or key cabinet. The k is geometric, generous and slightly rounded, integrated into the container rather than applied text. One single solid connected silhouette, clean negative space, balanced proportions, distinctive at 24px, understated mature developer-tool identity. No literal safe handle, no shield, no extra decorations.
